minutes.headline: Board will seek proposals for general counsel after a year of slow responses; two licenses granted
minutes.summary: The Select Board discussed frustration with slow legal counsel responses and agreed to review general counsel through a bake-off or RFP. It granted a peddlers license to a SolarCity solicitor and approved a manager change at Mickey Shay's. It also looked at pay-as-you-throw bag options, signed a letter to Unitil, heard committee reports and the interim town manager's first report, and directed follow-up on a bounced check from Kebab-alicious.

what_happened.line: The Select Board agreed to pursue a bake-off or RFP for general counsel after discussing slow legal responses; the town manager will report on options.
The board granted a peddlers license to a SolarCity solicitor.
The board accepted a manager change at Mickey Shay's.
The board deferred the pay-as-you-throw bag decision to the new town manager's recommendation, still aiming for January.
The board voted to accept a letter to Unitil and authorize the chair to sign it, and directed the town manager to follow up on a bounced check from Kebab-alicious.

why_it_matters: A change in who provides the town's legal advice, and how quickly, affects how fast contracts, licenses and disputes get resolved on residents' behalf.
The pay-as-you-throw bag choice will set what households pay and how they bag trash once it takes effect, with January as the target.
A returned check for a sewer grease trap non-compliance fee means the Sewer Commission has not yet collected that fee in full.
watch_next: The town manager's report on general counsel options (bake-off or RFP).
The new town manager's recommendation on pay-as-you-throw bags, aimed at January.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on all three votes and the main decisions, and most figure differences are caption garbling of the same amounts. The one substantive difference is that the official minutes record approval of the warrants while ours show none, and ours has a $10,000 town building RFP figure and PAYT bag prices that the official minutes lack.
